source.paraphrase: A residual may say `status=done` with a `result_ref`. That closes a slice. It does not close SPEC. Done close evidence must name `artifact_sha:` (sha256 of `result_ref` bytes) and `rollback:` a command — not captions (`CloseEvidence`). Collect refuses a mismatch or a slogan rollback. `integrate --apply` may set `done_when_closed` from a residual; `of phase` stays explicit; `of close` still needs RESOLVED.
